iOptron SkyGuider Pro

The tracker for serious Milky Way panoramas and telephoto nightscapes.

around $479

A compact equatorial tracker with an 11 lb payload capacity — enough for a DSLR, telephoto lens, and guidescope. Built-in polar scope, multiple tracking rates, and a ST-4 autoguider port for deep-sky work.

Why we like it

  • 11 lb payload — handles telephoto lenses easily
  • ST-4 port allows autoguiding for long exposures
  • Quiet, compact, runs on 8 AA batteries or USB

Keep in mind

  • Learning curve on polar alignment
  • Needs a sturdy tripod (sold separately)
  • Pricey next to the Star Adventurer 2i
